payload.text: hv cuts Utilz 2.14.9, 0132's fix, through devbin's core once 0132 lands (hv in vc's window, 2026-11-02, before the clock read 07:36Z by date -u): the first consumer cut in the new shape, ST0011 WP10 (utilz#ST0031). utilz-vc and utilz-dc bring vc and hv one plan first: tests.yml fires on candidate/** and not on tags (today it fires on main and tags, so pre-flight would refuse); tools/post-cut against the macOS leg the cut now runs at the release commit; a build: block wired to the cache. Its release check and dry run come to vc before hv cuts; every run books on this desk. After the cut vc reads its RELEASE seal for AC-3.4 (sign and notarise at the release commit as a leg), Utilz's part of AC-4.3, and AC-5.4 if a build: block is in. GO (hv in vc's window through the TUI, and in utilz-vc's at 08:22Z, Utilz vc decision 87; recorded 2026-11-02 08:23Z by date -u): utilz-vc's plan as sent. ST0031/04 by utilz-dc: U1 tests.yml (candidate/** trigger, tags dropped, macOS jobs on candidate refs) and U2 post-cut (app steps go; it keeps macos publish, since the cut attaches no app); then R1 post-cut 2.14.8 smoke, R2 release check, R3 dry run, each booked here; hv pushes main and vc reads CI; then hv's cut with a freeze. The build: block is not in this cut. After the cut, vc files the one core ask still wanted: the cut attaching macos.app in its object step, as bin-publish does for binaries (0.1.20's --pull covers the tap pull). RESUMED at hv's go of 2026-11-05 (decision 144), on devbin 0.1.20: utilz#0132 landed at efdd047d and closed at 58e45281, so the cut's precondition is met. The revised plan (Utilz decisions 89 and 90 at c54e89be, hv's go in utilz-vc's window) folds 0.1.20 in: hv's store-creds is done on rhadamanth, the only Mac that cuts Utilz (macos doctor: profile devbin PRESENT, one Developer ID identity, so no team:); release.formula stays undeclared and post-cut keeps the formula publish and the tap pull, since the object step attaches no Menuz.app.zip before a formula step would run (lib/cmd/release:2544, :3383-3402); 0313's pre-flight passes Menuz over, out of tree; U2 has no red arm at the base, a departure hv approved, since no suite names post-cut. R2 at the base read red as expected (utilz-dc's log r2-base-20261105T112042Z.log, sha256 a47682ca, 11:20:42Z to 11:20:44Z by its clock): the trigger, the one finding. Next: dc's step 5 as one READY (U1 tests.yml; U2 post-cut, docs/releasing.md and the config comment; CHANGELOG), vc's check of U1's four macOS sites (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/consumer-pass/utilz-u1-check.md, and no ref_type == 'tag' test left anywhere in the file), then on this desk R2 at the fix, R1 (vc reads post-cut first for any push to homebrew-utilz or upload to 2.14.8), R3 and the tree-scan files (common_lib.bats, arngz.bats, macos.bats and the pin sweep's), then hv's push with CI read by sha, and hv's cut with a freeze. AC-5.4 cannot come from this cut: no build: block, and Menuz builds out of tree.
